title: The starting hypothesis
body: A microbiome test for oncology clinics: predict toxicity, guide treatment and reduce the cost of side effects.

title: Cancer control came first
body: The first oncology interview put cancer control ahead of side-effect management. We needed to test that finding across more cancer types.

title: Users and buyers separated
body: The deck now distinguished oncologists as users from pharma and hospitals as buyers. Validation and economic evidence became explicit next steps.
